review_candidates.title: Director of Technology
review_candidates.description: About the Opportunity The organization knows that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world. That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, the organization partners with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology. The organization works shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential. Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, the organization helps educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive. Position As the organization's senior technology leader, this role will shape and execute the technology vision and strategy in direct support of the mission to ensure every student succeeds in school and in life. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this individual will provide strategic leadership across technology strategy, systems and security, AI governance, organizational technology adoption, and technology operations—driving decisions that enable educators to focus on what they do best: teaching. This is a role of significant influence and impact. This individual will not just manage infrastructure; they will architect the technology ecosystem that empowers the team to work shoulder-to-shoulder with school systems to overcome instructional challenges, foster collaboration, and ignite new possibilities at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology. Every decision made will ripple through the organization and ultimately support students' success. Leading a small, talented technology team, this role will ensure that the organization's technology investments are secure, scalable, sustainable, and—most importantly—effectively adopted across the organization. This individual will build organizational capacity to translate technology investments into everyday practices that drive real results. This is an opportunity to lead with vision, mentor emerging talent, and demonstrate how strategic technology leadership advances educational excellence. Key Responsibilities • Developing and executing multi-year technology roadmaps that align IT strategy with organizational priorities, scalability, and long-term sustainability. • Leading technology transformation and modernization initiatives across complex organizations, including managing change, building adoption, and ensuring staff readiness. • Establishing governance frameworks and policies for responsible AI adoption, data protection, cybersecurity, and organizational risk management. • Managing technology vendors, budgets, and investments while maximizing value and ensuring quality service delivery. • Translating complex technical concepts and strategic decisions into clear, compelling language for nontechnical leaders and stakeholders. • Building and developing high-performing teams, supporting professional growth, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and accountability. • Bridging technical solutions with organizational strategy and culture, ensuring technology serves people, mission, and organizational priorities rather than the reverse. • Taking on strategic challenges that require both deep technical expertise and thoughtful change leadership. Required Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and 10+ years of progressive experience in technology, IT, enterprise systems, digital transformation, or related areas. • Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities. • Proven track record leading technology transformation, modernization, or systems change across an organization, including successful change management and adoption. • Experience leading AI enablement, adoption, or governance within an organization, with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into responsible organizational use. • Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, enterprise systems, technology risk, and governance, with the ability to provide strategic oversight of these areas. • Experience developing and governing organizational technology policies and standards, including responsible AI use, data governance, and technology risk. • Experience overseeing technology vendors, external partners, technology investments, and budgets. • Proven ability to manage IT teams with a track record of supporting professional development and driving performance. Travel Requirements • This is a remote position that requires limited travel. • National travel for org retreats, programming, job related travel, donor meetings or professional development. • Outside of the above mentioned travel, this person will work from a home office that must be located anywhere within the U.S. Why Work Here Imagine being part of an organization where ideas and perspectives are highly valued. The organization believes in fostering individual strengths, encouraging personal growth, and embracing innovative ideas. If you thrive in a remote working environment, with the added excitement of travel, this is a perfect fit. By joining, you become part of a powerful community of peers nationwide. Regardless of location, you possess the power to make a significant impact on both students and teachers who rely on the organization daily. Join and become an integral part of driving progress in education. About the Mission & Values Mission: The organization partners with school systems to sustain the teaching, leadership, and conditions for every student to succeed in school and in life. Values • Build on strengths: Affirm and begin with the unique and collective talents, experiences, and wisdom of ourselves and others. • Continuously learn: Develop ourselves and others. Apply new learning and deepened self-awareness to relationships and practices. • Prioritize people: Build trust and reflect on the impact of different perspectives and experiences. • Champion success for all: Re-imagine structures, habits, and mindsets to ensure every learner has access to evidence-based learning opportunities. Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring • Artificial intelligence–enabled tools are used throughout the hiring process, from the moment a candidate applies through the offer stage, to support administrative tasks and the initial review of candidate materials. These tools help organize, analyze, and surface relevant information efficiently, but they do not make hiring decisions. • All candidate materials—including applications, resumes, assessments, and interview feedback—are reviewed and evaluated by people. All hiring decisions, including interview selection, advancement, and offers of employment, are made by humans. • AI is used solely as a support tool to assist with early-stage reviews and process efficiency. AI is not used in ways that discriminate based on protected characteristics, nor are ZIP codes or similar data used to target or exclude protected groups. Hiring practices are designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with equal employment opportunity standards. Benefits Compensation • The base salary range is $127,487 to $172,483 per year. Most new hires enter the range at a specific point based on their qualifications and the role level. For this position, the standard starting salary is $149,985, which is based on meeting the minimum requirement of 10 years of relevant experience. • If you have more than 10 years of directly relevant experience, your starting salary may be adjusted higher within the range, up to a maximum starting salary of $159,627. This approach ensures that candidates with additional experience beyond the minimum are recognized in the initial salary offer. Benefits: 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for individual employees. Additional premium costs are covered 60% by the organization for partners and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans. 4% matching 401k plan, Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, childcare and commuter expenses, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits are valued at or above $9,000 for employees. Time Off • First three years of employment, full time staff accrue 22 days a year. • Five additional days are accrued after the third and sixth year of employment. • The organization also offers 16 additional paid days off for various holidays, including three floating holidays staff may use at their discretion. Equal Opportunity Employment The organization is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

review_candidates.description: Oxybills Services India Pvt Ltd, established in 2017, specializes in building tailored, sustainable, and highly specialized digital platforms, web applications, websites, and tools for B2B clients. The company focuses on understanding and optimizing clients’ business processes to solve complex operational challenges, automate workflows, and streamline day-to-day activities. Oxybills delivers scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support digital transformation, including modernization of legacy systems and development of cloud-native and AI-driven tools. The team works with a modern technology stack including .NET, C#, ASP, JavaScript, HTML5, AI/ML, cloud platforms, Android, MAUI, Azure, and integrations for payments and social media, with strong attention to cybersecurity. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Database Administrator role based in Nagpur. The Database Administrator will be responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining database systems that support the company’s custom digital platforms and applications. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring database performance, optimizing queries, managing backups and recovery, and ensuring data security and integrity. The role involves designing and updating database schemas, implementing replication and high-availability strategies, and troubleshooting issues to minimize downtime. The Database Administrator will collaborate closely with developers and project teams to support application releases, refine data models, and improve overall system reliability. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Database Administration and Databases, including installation, configuration, monitoring, backup, and recovery. Candidates should possess solid capabilities in Database Design and data modeling to support scalable, secure, and high-performing applications. Candidates should possess proven Troubleshooting skills for diagnosing performance issues, resolving errors, and ensuring database stability. Candidates should possess experience with Replication and high-availability configurations to support business continuity and minimal downtime. Relevant experience with relational database systems (such as SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL) and familiarity with cloud database services (e.g., Azure SQL) is beneficial. A strong understanding of security best practices, including user access control, encryption, and compliance with data protection standards, is preferred. Effective collaboration and communication skills, along with the ability to document procedures and configurations clearly, are desirable. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in database administration, is advantageous.

WHAT YOU WILL DO Prepare and assemble visa and immigration applications across the destinations we serve, with new countries added as we expand Review client documents for completeness, accuracy and internal consistency before anything is filed Follow up with clients on outstanding requirements and keep them informed on what is still needed Submit applications through government portals, embassy systems and consular appointment platforms, then monitor status through to decision Keep case records, checklists and deadlines current in our case management systems Flag problems early: expiring documents, inconsistent dates, changed circumstances, approaching deadlines Draft forms, submission letters and supporting documents for review by our licensed consultants WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR One to three years of hands-on experience preparing or processing visa or immigration applications. We are deliberately not limiting this to one country. Canadian, American, Australian, British, Schengen, Japanese, Korean, Middle East deployment, anywhere at all. You will handle passports, financial records and personal documents every day. A bachelor's degree in any field HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED A track record of picking up an unfamiliar country's process quickly and getting it right Experience inside a licensed immigration consultancy, a law firm, or a recruitment agency Familiarity with monday.com, Dropbox or Google Workspace Background with a consulate, an embassy, or a DMW-licensed agency IF YOU ARE MORE EXPERIENCED We also hire at Senior Visa Processor level, with a higher salary band, ownership of your own caseload, and a hand in reviewing junior work. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive salary, set by experience On-site role at One Corporate Center, Ortigas Center, Pasig City, walking distance from Ortigas MRT and the surrounding business district All government-mandated benefits and 13th month pay Exposure to several countries' immigration systems, and a hand in building out new ones as we expand Direct working exposure to a Canadian licensed consulting practice, and a path into case management as we grow HOW TO APPLY Click Easy Apply and attach your CV. review_candidates.title: Senior consultant neurologist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Pediatric Assiut University Hospital is a leading academic medical center dedicated to providing specialized healthcare services to children and adolescents. The hospital combines clinical excellence with medical education and research, offering a collaborative environment for healthcare professionals to advance pediatric care. As part of a university system, the hospital emphasizes evidence-based practice, continuous learning, and multidisciplinary teamwork. Professionals joining the hospital can expect exposure to a wide range of pediatric conditions and access to ongoing professional development opportunities. Role Description The Senior Consultant Neurologist will provide advanced diagnostic and therapeutic care for pediatric patients with neurological disorders in both inpatient and outpatient settings. Responsibilities include conducting comprehensive neurological assessments, interpreting neuroimaging and electrophysiological studies, developing individualized management plans, and performing or supervising specialized procedures as appropriate. The role also involves leading multidisciplinary case discussions, mentoring junior medical staff and residents, contributing to clinical teaching, and participating in quality improvement and research initiatives. The Senior Consultant Neurologist will collaborate closely with other pediatric subspecialties to ensure coordinated care and clear communication with patients’ families. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Cairo, with primary on-site responsibilities at Pediatric Assiut University Hospital and some work-from-home duties, such as teleconsultations, documentation, and academic activities, as appropriate. Qualifications Advanced training and certification in pediatric neurology or neurology with substantial pediatric experience, along with a valid medical license and eligibility for consultant-level practice. Strong clinical expertise in diagnosing and managing a broad spectrum of pediatric neurological conditions, including epilepsy, neuromuscular disorders, developmental and neurogenetic conditions, and acute neurological emergencies. Proficiency in interpreting neurodiagnostic investigations, such as EEG, neuroimaging studies, and nerve conduction or EMG tests, and in integrating findings into comprehensive care plans. Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary teams, supervising and mentoring junior physicians and allied health professionals, and contributing to structured teaching programs. Commitment to evidence-based practice, participation in clinical audits or research projects, and engagement with continuous professional development and academic activities. Excellent communication skills for interacting with children and families, providing clear explanations of diagnoses and treatment options, and collaborating effectively with colleagues across departments. Strong organizational and time-management abilities, including maintaining accurate medical records, coordinating follow-up care, and adapting to a hybrid work model with both on-site and remote responsibilities. Prior experience in a university or teaching hospital setting is highly desirable; familiarity with regional healthcare systems and pediatric subspecialty networks is an advantage.

review_candidates.description: Company Description DEX EMPIRE LIMITED is a multinational brand group operating across sportswear manufacturing, retail distribution, club sponsorships, media, software development, and e-commerce. The company manages globally recognized ventures such as DEXIE Sportswear, a flagship brand providing professional-grade kits and apparel, and The Scents, one of South Africa’s largest drop-shipping fragrance businesses. DEX EMPIRE partners with organizations, retailers, and sports clubs worldwide to deliver high-performance products and media-driven fan engagement experiences. Its in-house software development capabilities support enterprise systems that streamline operations across divisions. The group has an international footprint across West Africa, Europe, South America, Southern Africa, and North America, offering opportunities to work in a fast-paced, globally connected environment. Role Description The Sales Business Development Executive is a full-time, hybrid role based in Lagos, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. This role focuses on identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, generating qualified leads, and building a robust sales pipeline across DEX EMPIRE’s sportswear and Dex Empire divisions. The person in this position will conduct market research, develop outreach strategies, present solutions to prospective clients, and manage follow-ups to close deals and meet revenue targets. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with potential and existing partners, preparing proposals and presentations, coordinating with internal teams to align offerings with client needs, and tracking performance metrics using CRM and reporting tools. The role also involves nurturing long-term relationships with key accounts, supporting contract negotiations, and contributing insights to improve sales processes and growth strategies. Qualifications Strong new business development and lead generation skills, with the ability to build and manage a high-quality sales pipeline. Solid business acumen, including understanding of commercial models, market dynamics, and revenue growth strategies. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for presentations, negotiations, and stakeholder engagement. Proven account management capabilities, including relationship building, client retention, and upselling or cross-selling. Previous experience in B2B sales, business development, or partnerships, ideally within sportswear, retail, media, software, or e-commerce sectors would be an advantage. Comfort using CRM systems, sales tracking tools, and basic data analysis to inform decision-making would be an advantage. Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams in Lagos and across global regions. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; demonstrated results in meeting or exceeding sales targets. What we offer •        A competitive salary with pay review on passing probation •        Bonus on every signed distributor and club agreement •        Commission on collected revenue •        Travel, data and airtime allowance

review_candidates.description: Org. Setting and Reporting Responsibilities The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda, promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system and serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment. The UNEP Regional Seas Programme, established in 1974, is the umbrella framework that brings together 18 Regional Seas Conventions and Action Plans, covering 146 countries. The Nairobi Convention is the Regional Seas for the Western Indian Ocean, providing the intergovernmental platform for its Contracting Parties to cooperate on the protection and sustainable management of the marine and coastal environment. The Contracting Parties to the Nairobi Convention have designated UNEP as the Secretariat of the Convention. The post of the Coordinator of the Nairobi Convention Secretariat is located in the UNEP's Ecosystems Division, in the Regional Seas Branch. The post of Secretariat of the Nairobi Convention is located in Nairobi duty station.
